shared_decisions.decision: Parameterisation of the height vector h (how zeros and positivity are handled)
shared_decisions.everyone: Optimise a strictly positive transform of h — log-h (exp), sqrt(h), or softplus(w) — so cells can approach but never exactly reach zero, and zeros are effectiv…
alternatives: Optimise h directly with a nonnegativity projection / active-set (zeros are reachable and revivable)
Optimise a sparse atom representation (positions + masses) so support is explicit and can grow/shrink

shared_decisions.decision: Objective smoothing of the inf-norm (how the max is made differentiable)
shared_decisions.everyone: Approach ||f*f||_inf from below via a smooth surrogate — log-sum-exp, top-k mean, or a fixed-argmax mask — annealed by a beta/k ladder
alternatives: Approach from above with a smooth upper bound (e.g. p-norm with p large, or a soft-max minus a margin)
Use exact subgradient / bundle methods on the true max with no surrogate at all

shared_decisions.decision: Search paradigm for the inner optimisation
shared_decisions.everyone: Gradient-based quasi-Newton (L-BFGS-B) or Adam on the full dense vector, with occasional exact coordinate sweeps
alternatives: Derivative-free global search (CMA-ES, differential evolution, simulated annealing) on a low-dimensional parametrisation
Convex/spectral relaxation: solve a semidefinite or spectral surrogate then round

shared_decisions.everyone: Fix a large N (8k–50k) and either optimise at full resolution or upsample a coarse solution with np.repeat / interpolation, capping at ~50k
alternatives: Adaptive mesh refinement: locally refine only near the argmax band and support edges
Continuous/off-grid formulation (positions as real variables) with no fixed N

shared_decisions.everyone: Start from the provided `start` (or a smooth analytic bump like a Gaussian/arcsine) and refine locally; restarts are perturbations of that same basin
alternatives: Multi-start from many structurally different families (spike trains, combs, random sparse supports) chosen by a global …
Construct a seed analytically from the known optimal f*f shape (e.g. inverse-problem solve for a target autocorrelation)

shared_decisions.decision: Handling of the L1 normalisation / scale freedom
shared_decisions.everyone: Keep h normalised (sum=1) or carry the L1 scale as a free variable inside the gradient, treating scale as continuous
alternatives: Fix the L1 norm exactly and optimise only the shape on the simplex
Explicitly search over discrete scale/support-size choices (branch on number of nonzero cells)

shared_decisions.everyone: A fixed hand-tuned phase schedule (confirm polish → surrogate ladder → coordinate/L-BFGS polish) with a hard CPU deadline and no online adaptation
alternatives: Adaptive budget allocation: measure per-phase gain rate and reallocate time dynamically
Anytime population/portfolio method running several strategies in parallel and selecting the best

shared_decisions.decision: Exploration mechanism to escape local optima
shared_decisions.everyone: Local perturbations of the incumbent — multiplicative noise, block scaling, translation shifts, or support rescaling — followed by re-polishing
alternatives: Basin-hopping with acceptance criterion (Metropolis) allowing temporary worsening
Deflation / topological moves: split or merge atoms, change the number of support components
